nodes.label: Service db (PostGIS 16)
nodes.rationale: Bound to 127.0.0.1 so only the host can reach it.

nodes.label: Service migrar (applies esquema/*.sql)
nodes.rationale: Runs every start; scripts are idempotent so existing DBs update without data loss.

nodes.label: Service tunel (Cloudflare quick tunnel, profile publico)
nodes.norm_label: service tunel (cloudflare quick tunnel, profile publico)
nodes.rationale: Free public HTTPS without account or domain; HTTPS is required for camera, GPS and offline on phones.

nodes.label: Inline theme/color preload script (anti-flicker)
nodes.rationale: Applies stored tema and color before first paint to avoid flicker; duplicates logic in src/shared/tema.ts.

nodes.label: Modo Campus (recomendación ¿voy a clase?)
nodes.rationale: Official institution notices take priority over every other signal.

nodes.label: Yty & Sumideros (reporte de basura con foto)
nodes.norm_label: yty & sumideros (reporte de basura con foto)
nodes.rationale: If AI fails the report is still saved as PENDIENTE so nothing is lost.

nodes.label: Agregar institución educativa (mapa OSM / API)
nodes.rationale: OpenStreetMap chosen because embedded Google Maps requires a billing-enabled key.

nodes.label: Caché de clima e IA (10 min por ciudad/campus)
nodes.norm_label: cache de clima e ia (10 min por ciudad/campus)
nodes.rationale: A thousand students viewing the same campus trigger one Open-Meteo and one Claude call.

nodes.label: Clean Architecture por módulo (domain/ports/use_cases/infra/api)
nodes.rationale: Business rules know nothing about HTTP or SQL, so tests swap AI, weather and DB for in-memory fakes and run the full API without network.

nodes.label: Motor nativo C++17 + pybind11 (grilla espacial)
nodes.rationale: Python clustering is O(n·groups) and slow in big storms; spatial grid gives ~O(n), releases the GIL, 47-53x faster, with automatic Python fallback and a parity test.

nodes.label: Zona Roja (anti-spam: 3 dispositivos ≤ 50 m)
nodes.rationale: Counting distinct devices (X-Device-Id) means a single phone reporting ten times cannot fabricate a Zona Roja.
